docs.title: Best Django Admin Interface Resources
docs.text: Tags: D x–y = Django versions declared on PyPI · release = date of the latest PyPI release (checked 2026-11). Links are verified monthly by an automated link check.

docs.title: Django Admin Themes & UI Enhancements
docs.text:
• django-admin-sortable2 - Generic drag-and-drop ordering for objects in the Django admin interface. [D 5.2–6.1 · release 2026-11]
  • Django Jazzmin - Drop-in theme for Django admin, utilizing AdminLTE 3 & Bootstrap 4. [D 4.2–6.0 · release 2026-06]
  • django-admin-interface - Customizable admin interface with modern flat theme. [D 4.0–6.0 · release 2025-12]
  • django-grappelli - A jazzy skin for the Django Admin Interface. [D 5.2–6.1 · release 2026-10]
  • django-jet-reboot - Modern admin template with enhanced functionality. [D >= 3.0 · release 2024-09]
  • simpleui - Modern theme based on Vue+Element-UI for Django admin. [no versions listed · release 2026-01]
  • django-admin-vol - Modern Bootstrap 5 Design. [no versions listed · release 2025-05]
  • Django Semantic - Free (MIT) Semantic UI admin theme. [no versions listed · release 2026-11]
  • django-baton - Modern, responsive Django admin based on Bootstrap 5. [D 4.2–6.1 · release 2026-11]
  • Black Dashboard Django - Open-source Django Template. [template, not a package]
  • Django Unfold - Modern Django admin theme for seamless interface development. [D 5.2–6.1 · release 2026-11]
  • Django Daisy - Mobile-friendly Django admin theme built with DaisyUI (TailwindCSS). [no versions listed · release 2026-08]

docs.title: Admin Extensions & Functional Enhancements
docs.text:
• django-admin-easy - Collection of admin fields and decorators. [no versions listed · release 2024-08]
  • django-admin-tools - Extensions/tools for Django administration. [D 1.11–6.1 · release 2026-11]
  • django-object-actions - Adds object tools for models in the admin. [no versions listed · release 2026-05]
  • django-hijack - Allows superusers to log in as another user. [D 5.2–6.1 · release 2026-10]
  • django-admin-env-notice - Visually distinguish environments in Django Admin. [no versions listed · release 2024-10]
  • django-mptt-admin - Provides a UI for managing MPTT models in Django Admin. [D 5.2–6.1 · release 2026-11]
  • django-mass-edit - Enables bulk changes in the Django admin interface. [no versions listed · last release 2023-08]
  • django-admin-charts - Create configurable charts from models and display them in Django admin. [D 5.2–6.1 · release 2026-10]

docs.title: Older or Deprecated Projects
docs.text:

  • django-fluent-dashboard - Improved django-admin-tools dashboard. [D 2.2–4.0 · last release 2021-11]
  • django-xadmin - Django admin replacement with plugin support. [no versions listed · last release 2016-07]
  • yawd-admin - Administration website for Django. [D 1.5 · last release 2013-10]
  • djamin - Alternative styling for Django admin. [no versions listed · not on PyPI]
  • djangocms-admin-style - Django CMS Admin Style tailored for django CMS. [D 2.2–5.0 · release 2024-02]
  • django-admin-bootstrap - Responsive Skin for Django Admin. [D 1.11–3.0 · not on PyPI]
  • django-admin-bootstrapped - A Django admin theme using Twitter Bootstrap. [D 1.8 · last release 2015-12]
  • django-jet - Modern responsive template for the admin interface. [no versions listed · last release 2018-10]
  • django-material - Material design for Django Forms and Admin. [D 2.2–4.0 · last release 2023-05]
  • django-suit - Modern theme for Django admin interface. [no versions listed · last release 2019-10]
  • django-wpadmin - WordPress look and feel for Django admin panel. [D 1.8 · last release 2020-04]
  • django-adminlte2 - Django AdminLTE2 theme using AdminLTE3. [no versions listed · last release 2020-06]
  • django-admin2 - Extendable Django admin rewrite. [no versions listed · last release 2017-01]

docs.title: 🚀 Django Resources and Libraries for easy development
📡 API Development
docs.text:
1. Django REST Framework - Web APIs for Django.
  2. django-ninja - Fast Django REST framework based on type annotations.
  3. django-tastypie - Creating APIs for Django apps since 2010.

docs.title: 🔒 Authentication & Authorization
docs.text:
1. dj-rest-auth - Authentication for Django Rest Framework.
  2. django-rest-knox - Authentication module for dj-rest-auth.
  3. djoser - REST implementation of Django authentication.
  4. django-rest-framework-simplejwt - JSON web tokens for DRF.
  5. django-axes - Protects Django from brute-force login attempts.
  6. django-allauth - Authentication, registration, and social login integration.
  7. django-guardian - Implements per-object permissions for Django models.

docs.title: 📑 API Documentation & OpenAPI Schema Generation
docs.text:
1. drf-yasg - Swagger/OpenAPI schema generation for DRF.
  2. drf-spectacular - Sane OpenAPI 3 schema generation for DRF.
  3. django-rest-swagger - Integrates DRF with Swagger documentation.
  4. drf-openapi-tester - Automatically tests your APIs with OpenAPI specifications.

docs.title: 🌐 CORS & Webhooks
docs.text:
1. django-cors-headers - Handles CORS when back-end and front-end are on different servers.
  2. django-webhook - For sending outgoing webhooks on model changes.

docs.title: 🔮 GraphQL for Django
docs.text:
1. graphene-django - GraphQL integration for Django.
  2. graphene-django-filter - Advanced GraphQL filters for Django with logical operators.
  3. graphene-django-extras - Extends graphene-django with extra features like full-text search.

docs.title: 🛠️ Other Utilities
docs.text:
1. djaq - Instant remote API to Django models with a powerful query language.
  2. django-webpack-loader - Use Webpack with Django seamlessly.

docs.title: 🧪 Development & Testing Tools
docs.text:
1. pytest-django - Integrates pytest with Django for enhanced testing.
  2. factory_boy - For generating fake data for testing and development.
  3. django-debug-toolbar - A set of panels for debugging Django queries, templates, etc.
  4. coverage.py - Measures code coverage for your Django tests.
  5. django-model-utils - Provides utilities for Django models, including TimeStampedModel, StatusModel, and others.
  6. django-test-plus - Enhances Django’s test suite with extra utilities.
  7. pytest-factoryboy - Integrates factory_boy with pytest for test fixtures.

docs.title: ⚡ Performance & Caching
docs.text:
1. django-redis - Uses Redis as a caching backend for improved performance.
  2. django-debug-toolbar-request-history - Extends Debug Toolbar for request history tracking.
  3. django-storages - Easy file storage integration for cloud services like AWS S3.
  4. django-silk - Profiling tool for Django that tracks SQL queries, cache usage, and request times.
  5. django-celery-results - Stores results of Celery tasks in Django's database.
  6. django-compressor - Compresses linked and inline JavaScript and CSS into a single cached file.

docs.title: 📂 File Management & Uploads
docs.text:
1. django-filebrowser - A file management system for easy media management in Django.
  2. django-imagekit - Toolkit for image processing like resizing and thumbnails.

docs.title: 🛡️ Security & Authentication
docs.text:
1. django-secure - Set of security extensions for Django to protect against XSS, CSRF, etc.
  2. django-two-factor-auth - Adds two-factor authentication to Django apps.
  3. django-passwords - Provides password validation and policy enforcement.
  4. django-otp - Adds support for one-time password systems in Django.

docs.title: 🕒 Task Scheduling & Background Jobs
docs.text:
1. django-celery - Integrates Celery with Django for background tasks and task queues.
  2. django-background-tasks - A simpler background task processing library for Django.
  3. django-q - Multi-queue system for Django to handle asynchronous tasks.

docs.title: 📊 Data Import/Export
docs.text:
1. django-import-export - Import and export model data to/from formats like CSV, Excel, JSON.
  2. django-modeltranslation - Adds multilingual fields for translating content in Django models.
  3. django-data-wizard - A data import/export utility with a UI for Django.

docs.title: 🎨 Frontend & UI Integration
docs.text:
1. django-webpack-loader - Integrate Webpack with Django for front-end asset management.
  2. django-sass - Integrates Sass for CSS preprocessing in Django.
  3. django-crispy-forms - Better form rendering with a cleaner layout.
  4. django-formtools - Provides form utilities like multi-step forms for Django.

docs.title: 🌍 Internationalization & Localization
docs.text:
1. django-rosetta - UI for translating Django .po files.
  2. django-modeltranslation - Enables multilingual fields for your models.

docs.title: Best Django Admin Interface Resources
docs.text: Welcome to our curated collection of Django Admin Interface resources! This project aims to help developers create beautiful, efficient, and user-friendly admin interfaces in Django applications.

docs.title: 🌟 Why Contribute?
docs.text:
• Help fellow developers discover the best admin interface solutions
  • Share your knowledge and experience with the community
  • Make Django development more accessible and enjoyable
  • Be part of an active open-source community

docs.title: 🤝 Our Contributors
docs.text: We are proud of our growing community of contributors who help make this resource better every day:

docs.title: 🎯 How You Can Help
docs.text:
• Share your favorite Django admin themes and packages
  • Add tutorials and implementation guides
  • Improve documentation and examples
  • Report bugs and suggest improvements
  • Review and enhance existing content

docs.title: 🚀 Get Started
docs.text:
Ready to contribute? We welcome contributions of all sizes! Whether it's fixing a typo or adding a new resource, your help is valuable.

Check our Contributing Guidelines to get started.

docs.title: 💬 Join the Community
docs.text:
Have questions or suggestions? Feel free to: - Open an issue - Submit a pull request

Together, we can make Django admin development easier and more enjoyable for everyone!

⭐ Don't forget to star this repository if you find it helpful!

docs.title: Contributing Guidelines
docs.text: Thank you for considering contributing to Best-Django-Admin-interface! This document outlines the process for contributing to this project.

docs.title: How to Contribute
docs.text:
1. Fork the repository
  2. Create a new branch (git checkout -b feature/improvement)
  3. Make your changes
  4. Run tests if applicable
  5. Commit your changes (git commit -am 'Add new feature')
  6. Push to the branch (git push origin feature/improvement)
  7. Create a Pull Request

docs.title: Pull Request Guidelines
docs.text:
• Clearly describe the problem and solution
  • Include the relevant issue number if applicable
  • Update documentation as needed
  • Add tests if you're adding new functionality
  • Follow existing code style and conventions

docs.title: Code of Conduct
docs.text:
• Be respectful and inclusive
  • Keep discussions professional
  • Help others when possible
  • Report inappropriate behavior

docs.title: Questions?
docs.text:
• Open an issue for general questions
  • Contact maintainers for sensitive issues

Thank you for your contributions!
